Here is a JSON schema:

{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "title": "Scene",
  "description": "A Scene defines a set of properties and Elements to be shared among multile Pages. It also defines a background music to be played when one of those Pages is active.\nA Page is always associated with a Scene, either explicity with the \"scene\" property or implicitly with the default scene with name \"*\".\nThe Page inherits all the properties from the associated scene, including Elements. When the same property is specified both in the Page and the Scene, the value specified in the Page will be used. The only exception to this rule is Elements, which will be deep-merged (deep-inheritance). Elements with the id property will be merged, and other Elements will be appended (Elements defined in the Scene are always placed below Elements specified in the page).",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {},
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": []
}

Write a JSON object that validates against this schema. Your answer must contain nothing but JSON.

schema.title: Scene
schema.description:
A Scene defines a set of properties and Elements to be shared among multile Pages. It also defines a background music to be played when one of those Pages is active.
A Page is always associated with a Scene, either explicity with the "scene" property or implicitly with the default scene with name "*".
The Page inherits all the properties from the associated scene, including Elements. When the same property is specified both in the Page and the Scene, the value specified in the Page will be used. The only exception to this rule is Elements, which will be deep-merged (deep-inheritance). Elements with the id property will be merged, and other Elements will be appended (Elements defined in the Scene are always placed below Elements specified in the page).

{
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#",
  "description": "This is a list of entries in RNAcentral to be imported by ensembl. This list should be kept small enough to easily fit in memory and thus not all entries at once.",
  "items": {
    "description": "This is an entry in RNAcentral that is active (has at least 1 active xref)",
    "properties": {
      "description": {
        "description": "Human readable name of the sequence",
        "minLength": 1,
        "type": "string"
      },
      "md5": {
        "description": "The MD5 hash of the sequence in lowercase",
        "pattern": "^[a-f\\d]{32}$",
        "type": "string"
      },
      "rna_type": {
        "description": "The INSDC type of the sequence",
        "enum": [
          "RNase_MRP_RNA",
          "RNase_P_RNA",
          "SRP_RNA",
          "Y_RNA",
          "antisense_RNA",
          "autocatalytically_spliced_intron",
          "guide_RNA",
          "hammerhead_ribozyme",
          "lncRNA",
          "miRNA",
          "misc_RNA",
          "ncRNA",
          "other",
          "piRNA",
          "precursor_RNA",
          "rRNA",
          "rasiRNA",
          "ribozyme",
          "sRNA",
          "scRNA",
          "scaRNA",
          "siRNA",
          "snRNA",
          "snoRNA",
          "tRNA",
          "telomerase_RNA",
          "tmRNA",
          "vault_RNA"
        ]
      },
      "rnacentral_id": {
        "description": "The specific specific URS of the sequence in RNAcentral",
        "pattern": "^URS[A-Z0-9]{10}_\\d+$",
        "type": "string"
      },
      "sequence": {
        "description": "The sequence in uppercase with U's.",
        "minLength": 10,
        "pattern": "^[ACGTYRWSKMDVHBNXFI]+$",
        "type": "string"
      },
      "taxon_id": {
        "description": "NCBI taxon id of the organism",
        "type": "number"
      },
      "xrefs": {
        "description": "A list of cross references that other databases can use. These will only be the 'high quality' references from RNAcentral.",
        "items": {
          "description": "This represents a reference from this sequence to a different high quality database that RNAcentral can provide",
          "properties": {
            "database": {
              "description": "Human readable name of the database this Xref comes from",
              "enum": [
                "GtRNAdb",
                "lncRNAdb",
                "miRBase",
                "Modomics",
                "PDBe",
                "SNOpy",
                "srPDB",
                "tmRNA Website",
                "Rfam"
              ]
            },
            "id": {
              "description": "ID of this sequence in this database",
              "minLength": 1,
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "database",
            "id"
          ],
          "title": "RNAcentral Cross-reference",
          "type": "object"
        },
        "type": "array",
        "_uniqueItems": true
      }
    },
    "required": [
      "rnacentral_id",
      "description",
      "sequence",
      "md5",
      "rna_type",
      "taxon_id",
      "xrefs"
    ],
    "title": "RNAcentral Entry",
    "type": "object"
  },
  "minItems": 1,
  "type": "array",
  "_uniqueItems": true
}

schema.title: X-Wing Squadron Format Schema

amount.description: Defines an amount value (to 2 decimal places), between 0 and 99999999999.99

specifiedYear.title: Total Gift Aid Payments.
specifiedYear.description: The total amount of Gift Aid payments made within the specified tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

oneOffSpecifiedYear.title: Total One Off Gift Aid Payments.
oneOffSpecifiedYear.description: The amount of one-off Gift Aid payments made within the specified tax year that has been included in giftAidPayments.specifiedYear. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

specifiedYearTreatedAsPreviousYear.title: Total Gift Aid payments made in the current tax year but treated as if they were mae in the previous tax year.
specifiedYearTreatedAsPreviousYear.description: The amount of Gift Aid payments made within the specified tax year that should be treated as if they were made in the previous tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

followingYearTreatedAsSpecifiedYear.title: Total Gift Aid payments made in the next tax year but treated as if they were made in the current tax year.
followingYearTreatedAsSpecifiedYear.description: The amount of Gift Aid payments made in the following tax year that should be treated as if they were made in the specified tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

nonUKCharities.title: Value of Gift Aid payments to non-UK charities.
nonUKCharities.description: The total amount of Gift Aid payments made within the specified tax year to a charity outside the UK that has been included in giftAidPayments.specifiedYear. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

nonUKCharityNames.title: Non-UK Charity Names.
nonUKCharityNames.description: Names of all non-UK charities that received gift aid payments where the amounts have been included in giftAidPayments.nonUkCharities. If giftAidPayments.nonUkCharities is greater than zero then this field is required. Each name should be between 1 and 75 characters in length. Allowed characters, including spaces are: mixed case alphanumeric characters and the characters: &'()*,-./@£

sharesOrSecurities.title: Value of qualifying shares or securities gifted to charity.
sharesOrSecurities.description: The net benefit of shares and securities minus any amounts of benefits received from the charity. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

landAndBuildings.title: Value of qualifying land and buildings gifted to charity.
landAndBuildings.description: The net benefit of land and buildings minus any amounts or benefits received from the charity. This should include any costs of the gift or sale such as legal or valuer's fees. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

investmentsNonUKCharities.title: Value of qualifying investments gifted to non-UK charities.
investmentsNonUKCharities.description: The net amount of gifts of shares or securities or land and buildings that was made to a charity outside the UK that has been included in gifts.sharesOrSecurities and gifts.landAndBuildings. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

investmentsNonUKCharityNames.title: Non-UK Investment Charity Names.
investmentsNonUKCharityNames.description: Names of all non-UK charities that received investments where the amounts are included in gifts.investmentsNonUKCharities. If gifts.investmentsNonUKCharities is greater than zero, then this field is required. Each name should be between 1 and 75 characters in length. Allowed characters, including spaces are: mixed case alphanumeric characters and the characters: &'()*,-./@£

schema.title: geometry
schema.description:
A geometry is a GeoJSON object where the type member's value is one of the following strings: "Point", "MultiPoint", "LineString", "MultiLineString", "Polygon", "MultiPolygon", or "GeometryCollection".

A GeoJSON geometry object of any type other than "GeometryCollection" must have a member with the name "coordinates". The value of the coordinates member is always an array. The structure for the elements in this array is determined by the type of geometry.

ISO 19115-2: EX_Extent > geographicElement > EX_BoundingPolygon > polygon > [Point | LineString | Polygon > [interior | exterior] | MultiGeometry]

coordinates.description: The position representing a point, represented by an array of numbers following x, y, z order (easting, northing, altitude for coordinates in a projected coordinate reference system, or longitude, latitude, altitude for coordinates in a geographic coordinate reference system).

ISO 19115-2: EX_Extent > geographicElement > EX_BoundingPolygon > polygon > Point > coordinates

oneOf.title: MultiPoint
oneOf.description: A geographic object comprised of multiple points.

ISO 19115-2: EX_Extent > geographicElement > EX_BoundingPolygon > polygon > MultiGeometry > geometryMembers > Point[ ]

coordinates.description: The set of positions that constitute the MultiPoint geometry.

ISO 19115-2: EX_Extent > geographicElement > EX_BoundingPolygon > polygon > MultiGeometry > geometryMembers > Point[ ] > coordinates

oneOf.title: LineString
oneOf.description: A geometry object comprised of a minimum of two positions.

coordinates.description: The set of positions that constitute the LineString geometry.

ISO 19115-2: EX_Extent > geographicElement > EX_BoundingPolygon > polygon > LineString > coordinates

oneOf.title: MultiLineString
oneOf.description: A geometry object comprised of one or more LineStrings.

ISO 19115-2: EX_Extent > geographicElement > EX_BoundingPolygon > polygon > MultiGeometry > geometryMembers > LineString[ ]

coordinates.description: The set of LineString(s) that constitute the MultiLineString.

ISO 19115-2: EX_Extent > geographicElement > EX_BoundingPolygon > polygon > MultiGeometry > geometryMembers > LineString[ ] > coordinates

oneOf.title: Polygon
oneOf.description:
A geometry object that is composed of a set of LinearRings. A LinearRing is a closed LineString with 4 or more positions. The first and last positions are equivalent (they represent equivalent points).

For Polygons with multiple rings, the first must be the exterior ring and any others must be interior rings or holes.

oneOf.title: MultiPolygon
oneOf.description: A geometry object comprised of multiple polygons.

ISO 19115-2: EX_Extent > geographicElement > EX_BoundingPolygon > polygon > MultiGeometry > geometryMembers > Polygon[ ]

coordinates.description: The set of Polygons that constitute the MultiPolygon.

ISO 19115-2: EX_Extent > geographicElement > EX_BoundingPolygon > polygon > MultiGeometry > geometryMembers > Polygon[ ] > [exterior > LinearRing > coordinates | interior[ ] > LinearRing > coordinates]

position.title: position
position.description: A position is the fundamental geometry construct. A position is represented by an array of numbers following x, y, z order (easting, northing, altitude for coordinates in a projected coordinate reference system, or longitude, latitude, altitude for coordinates in a geographic coordinate reference system).

lineString.title: lineString
lineString.description: An array of two or more positions

allOf.title: minimum 2
allOf.description: The LineString must consist of two or more positions

linearRing.title: LinearRing
linearRing.description: An array of a minimum of four positions where the first equals the last

allOf.title: minimum 4
allOf.description: A LinearRing is a closed LineString with 4 or more positions.

polygon.title: Polygon
polygon.description: A set of LinearRings that constitute a Polygon geometry. For Polygons with multiple rings, the first must be the exterior ring and any others must be interior rings or holes.

ISO 19115-2: EX_Extent > geographicElement > EX_BoundingPolygon > polygon > Polygon > [exterior > LinearRing > coordinates | interior[ ] > LinearRing > coordinates]

schema.description: User metrics establish how aggregate functions can be used to update a custom user field with respect to an event.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: A unique identifier for this metric. This should be an ObjectId.

customFieldKey.title: Custom Field
customFieldKey.description: The name of the custom field associated with this metric.

aggregateId.title: Aggregate Identifier
aggregateId.description: An unique identifier for the aggregate operation to perform.

dateTriggeredWindow.title: Date Triggered Window
dateTriggeredWindow.description: An ISO 8601 interval. The aggregate operation will only be performed between this window.

eventKey.title: Event Key
eventKey.description: The event that will be aggregated by this metric.

fieldsFilters.title: Metric Fields Filters
fieldsFilters.description: The aggregate operation will only be performed for events matching these filters

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: A JSONata expression which will filter out non-matching events

diff.title: Throttle Interval
diff.description: The minimum interval time that can elapse between recording the value of field name. Default is milliseconds per hour.

fieldName.title: Field Name
fieldName.description: The field on which this aggregate will be performed.

operator.title: Operator
operator.description: The operator that will be used in applying the filter

value.title: OR Filters
value.description: Filters provided will be evaluated using the OR conditional.

field.title: Field Name
field.description: The filter operator will be applied to this event field

value.title: Field Value
value.description: The value the filter operator will match on

Certificate.description: DER-encoded certificate data if an institutional recovery key will be added.

Defer.description: Set to true to defer enabling FileVault until the designated user logs out. For details, see fdesetup(8). The person enabling FileVault must be either a local user or a mobile account user.

DeferDontAskAtUserLogout.description: When using the Defer option, set this key to true to not request enabling FileVault at user logout time.

DeferForceAtUserLoginMaxBypassAttempts.description: When using the Defer option you can optionally set this key to the maximum number of times the user can bypass enabling FileVault before it will require that it be enabled before the user can log in. If set to 0, it will always prompt to enable FileVault until it is enabled, though it will allow you to bypass enabling it. Setting this key to –1 will disable this feature.

Enable.description: Set to 'On' to enable FileVault. Set to 'Off' to disable FileVault. This value is required.

OutputPath.description: Path to the location where the recovery key and computer information plist will be stored.

Password.description: User password of the Open Directory user that will be added to FileVault. Use the UserEntersMissingInfo key if you want to prompt for this information.

PayloadCertificateUUID.description: UUID of the payload containing the asymmetric recovery key certificate payload.

PayloadIdentifier.description: A unique identifier for the payload, dot-delimited.  Usually root PayloadIdentifier+subidentifier

PayloadOrganization.description: This value describes the issuing organization of the profile, as displayed to the user

PayloadType.description: The type of the payload, a reverse dns string

PayloadVersion.description: The version of the whole configuration profile.

ShowRecoveryKey.description: Set to false to not display the personal recovery key to the user after FileVault is enabled

UseKeychain.description: If set to true and no certificate information is provided in this payload, the keychain already created at /Library/Keychains/FileVaultMaster.keychain will be used when the institutional recovery key is added.

UseRecoveryKey.description: Set to true to create a personal recovery key

UserEntersMissingInfo.description: Set to true for manual profile installs to prompt for missing user name or password fields.

Username.description: User name of the Open Directory user that will be added to FileVault.
